cases.input: One approved control revision is cited by three independent risk assessments.
cases.expect: The control keeps one identity while each risk retains an independent assessment context and reliance decision.

cases.input: A failed execution is evidence for one assessment population and period but outside two others.
cases.expect: Only the covered effectiveness determination is invalidated; the other risks record no automatic causal change.

cases.input: The mechanism changes and a successor control revision becomes effective.
cases.expect: Prior revisions and assessment citations remain resolvable while new reliance pins the successor revision.

cases.input: A policy dashboard is green and closes all risks citing its control.
cases.expect: Closure is rejected because policy status is neither control effectiveness nor risk acceptance.

cases.input: Residual likelihood is lowered because the control is documented, with no current effectiveness determination.
cases.expect: The estimate is invalid and reliance remains unknown.

cases.input: A risk relies on an effectiveness determination after its validity period and invalidation trigger.
cases.expect: The assessment context becomes stale and cannot justify residual-risk reduction.

cases.input: Three risks sharing one control are merged into one risk record.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected because shared control dependence does not erase risk identities.
